notes:
## BondoMod 0.2.45

- Added a Home page with session time, Auto GG, Discord Rich Presence, menu backgrounds, and ticker controls.
- Added Ping Spoof controls with configurable ranges and client-side or Plus server-side mode.
- Added Extended Camera Settings and moved Macros into the plugin manager.
- Reorganized the F2 menu and simplified overlay controls, with drag positioning and a controller design preview.
- Fixed item spawning and immediate item deletion, and improved Rank Display timing and placement.
- Fixed launch preparation and recovery behavior for bundled game UI controls.
